deck: 考研英语::外刊精读::The Economist

cards.Back: 灾难，严重灾祸；比 disaster 更正式。
cards.Extra: Article context: AI has not yet caused a calamity, but it might.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels vocabulary

cards.Back: 自愿性标准；指行业或企业自愿遵守的规范。
cards.Extra: Writing topic: technology governance and corporate responsibility.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels vocabulary technology

cards.Back: 加装安全限制或防护栏的模型。
cards.Extra: guardrail 在 AI 语境中表示安全边界、限制机制。
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels vocabulary AI

cards.Back: 出口管制；政府限制关键技术、产品或服务流向海外。
cards.Extra: Useful for topics: technology competition, national security, global trade.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels vocabulary

cards.Front: make up rules on the fly
cards.Back: 边做边定规则，临时拼凑规则。
cards.Extra: Negative policy comment: The government seemed to make up rules on the fly.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels phrase

cards.Back: 民族主义色彩；tinge 表示轻微的色彩、意味。
cards.Extra: Article context: policy decisions had an unpleasant nationalistic tinge.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels phrase

cards.Back: 优先于，重要性高于。
cards.Extra: Writing: Public safety should take precedence over private profit.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels phrase writing

cards.Back: 前沿人工智能；通常指能力最强、风险也最高的新一代 AI 模型。
cards.Extra: Article context: regulating frontier AI is tricky.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels vocabulary AI

cards.Back: 开放权重模型；模型参数开放，用户可以运行或改动。
cards.Extra: Do not confuse with open-source software; open-weight may not mean all code/data are open.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels vocabulary AI

cards.Back: 摆弄、修补、改动；常指小幅调整。
cards.Extra: Article context: anyone can run or tinker with open-weight models.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels phrase

cards.Back: 严厉打击、加强管制。
cards.Extra: Example: Governments may crack down on illegal use of personal data.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels phrase writing

cards.Back: 蒸馏；AI 中指用强模型输出训练另一个模型。
cards.Extra: Article context: American labs are cracking down on distillation.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels vocabulary AI

cards.Back: 行不通的，不可操作的。
cards.Extra: Writing: A permanent ban on technology is often unworkable.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels vocabulary writing

cards.Back: 可塑的，易调整的。
cards.Extra: Article context: Chinese models are cheap and malleable.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels vocabulary

cards.Front: a gulf between A and B
cards.Back: A 与 B 之间的巨大鸿沟。
cards.Extra: Writing: There is a gulf between urban and rural educational resources.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels phrase writing

cards.Back: 压住、封存、阻止释放。
cards.Extra: Article context: regulators might bottle up several generations of AI advances.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels phrase

cards.Back: 分阶段发布、错峰发布。
cards.Extra: Useful for policy design: an evaluation period and a staggered release.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels phrase technology

cards.Back: 使正式化，使制度化。
cards.Extra: Writing: Voluntary standards should be formalised when public safety is at stake.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels vocabulary writing

cards.Back: 微观管理，过度干预细节。
cards.Extra: Article view: politicians should not micromanage model evaluation.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels vocabulary

cards.Back: 讨价还价，政治交易；常带贬义。
cards.Extra: Article context: politicians should not horse-trade with AI companies.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels vocabulary

cards.Back: 退后，不插手细节。
cards.Extra: Writing: Once clear goals are set, leaders should stand back.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels phrase writing

cards.Back: 整合，合并。
cards.Extra: Article context: amalgamate knowledge from AI labs, research groups and foreign bodies.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels vocabulary

cards.Back: 建立筹码、增强议价能力。
cards.Extra: Writing: Young people should build leverage through useful skills.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels phrase writing

cards.Back: 失效保护，备用机制。
cards.Extra: Writing: Societies need fail-safes against technological and economic shocks.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels vocabulary writing

cards.Back: 结构：The intelligence + that 定语从句 + also + 谓语。含义：同一种能力既带来风险，也带来价值。
cards.Extra: Imitation: The connectivity that makes social media distracting also makes it valuable for education.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels grammar writing

cards.Front: Grammar: Once those goals are set, politicians should stand back.
cards.Back: Once 引导时间状语从句，表示“一旦……就……”。
cards.Extra: Imitation: Once basic rules are set, schools should be given room to innovate.
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels grammar writing

cards.Back: Frontier AI needs regulation, but regulation should be formal, technical, staged and internationally resilient, not improvised or purely nationalistic.
cards.Extra: 作文迁移：AI 监管、科技伦理、社会责任、国际合作。
cards.Tags: 外刊精读 Rules_for_supermodels macro writing
